description.value: Travelodge by Wyndham Kamloops is a mid-range chain hotel situated on Columbia Street in Kamloops, a major interior BC city and natural waypoint for cyclists travelling the Trans-Canada or Thompson Valley routes. Part of the global Travelodge brand under Wyndham, it offers standard hotel-style accommodations in a commercially serviced area with easy access to downtown amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched is almost entirely Wyndham corporate navigation boilerplate, with no property-specific amenity details for the Kamloops location visible in any of the subpages retrieved. OSM provides the core identifiers (address, phone, internet_access=wlan) but per the rules OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration. Wi-Fi is tagged in OSM but unconfirmed by website content, so it is left null. The hotel booking interface is active, confirming the property is open.
